svg.aria-label: Terminal output: python -I demo.py --out demo-run (its closing table)

g.text: closing table: one line per step and case
PASS story 1 init a new desk; 10 starting contacts in the practice CRM
PASS story 2 ingest the file 27 new enquiries, 3 replays
PASS story 3 report the states add up: 27 enquiries + 3 replays = 30 arrived
PASS story 4 dry run (plan) plans printed; nothing written to the CRM
PASS story 5 resolve 1, approve 5 a person resolves a hold, then approves 5 plans by sha256
PASS story 6 apply 5 written: 1 new contact; 4 returning contacts updated
PASS story 7 ingest it again 0 new, 30 replays; nothing new written
PASS story 8 apply again nothing approved; nothing written
PASS story 9 report again the states add up: 27 enquiries + 33 replays = 60 arrived
PASS story 10 doctor the doctor: 20 of 20 checks passed
PASS replay-three-times one contact, one note; the edited copy shown
PASS returning-contact no second contact; empty field filled; phone shown, kept
PASS two-contacts-held held, no plan; resolved as contact 7, then as 8
PASS possible-duplicate-held held, no plan; resolved as new, then as contact 5
PASS inputs-not-taken 7 not taken, each with its reason; model and CRM untouched
PASS hidden-instruction waits for a person; the answer with a 5th key not used
PASS ai-answer-not-used a figure not in the message: not used; plan the same
PASS apply-without-approval the gate stops it: no approval; nothing written
PASS approval-for-another-plan the CRM changed since approval: planned again, waits
PASS apply-twice the approval is used once; the second apply writes nothing
PASS crm-down-then-retry apply_failed, named; the retry completed; nothing doubled
PASS wrong-secret 401; nothing kept
PASS no-secret-configured 503: no secret configured, every request is turned away
total: 23 of 23 steps and cases as expected
